summary: ArriVent BioPharma filed a Form 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing via Item 7.01 (Regulation FD) and Item 8.01 (Other Events) a press release dated October 12, 2026, announcing that the first patient was dosed in the U.S. Phase 1 trial (NCT07755436) of ARR-002, a potential first-in-class MUC16/NaPi2b dual-target tetravalent antibody-drug conjugate for ovarian and endometrial cancer. No financial terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics were stated. This is a routine clinical-development disclosure, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
